title: [CQ-M07l] JetBrains Accounts tab: VM token action
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8). Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation, decision 5. Depends on CQ-M07k (task-324d4f53: the `accounts vm-token` CLI and the presence flag) and on CQ-M07o (task-8dbc76d7), so the two JetBrains slices never edit util/TerminalAgentLauncher.kt at the same time.

Objective: the human can mint, replace and remove each rotation account's VM token from the JetBrains Accounts tab, and see which accounts have one, without the plugin ever touching a token.

Deliverable (moe-jetbrains, JetBrains only: VS Code has no Accounts tab; CQ-M07's docs say so):
- An Accounts tab action per account that opens a terminal running `accounts vm-token <id>` (and one for `--remove`), through the same path sign-in uses (TerminalAgentLauncher runAccountsCommand / accountsCommandLine / buildAccountsCommand): the same shells (POWERSHELL, WSL_BASH, BASH), quoting and WSL path handling.
- A per-account VM-token indicator from CQ-M07k's presence flag. A daemon that sends no flag (an older daemon) shows unknown, never present.

NOT in scope: token storage and minting (CQ-M07k); launch routing (CQ-M07o).

Verification: ./gradlew test under the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease): cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun", or a snapshot run of the exact commit.
definitionOfDone: The action builds `accounts vm-token <id>` and `accounts vm-token <id> --remove` command lines for the POWERSHELL, WSL_BASH and BASH shells with the same quoting as sign-in (JUnit on the pure builder).
The indicator shows present, absent and unknown (flag missing) per account (JUnit on the pure presentation).
The command line carries no token argument and the plugin never reads the token store (JUnit plus code review note in the completion).
